def transform(g):
    import numpy as np
    a=np.array(g); out=a.copy(); H,W=a.shape
    seen=np.zeros_like(a,bool)
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if a[i,j]==8 or seen[i,j]: continue
            # BFS component of non-8 cells
            comp=[(i,j)]; seen[i,j]=True; k=0
            while k<len(comp):
                r,c=comp[k]; k+=1
                for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
                    if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and a[nr,nc]!=8 and not seen[nr,nc]:
                        seen[nr,nc]=True; comp.append((nr,nc))
            cells=[a[r,c] for r,c in comp]
            col=set(cells)-{0}
            c=col.pop()
            pat=[(r,c2) for r,c2 in comp if a[r,c2]==c]
            r0=min(r for r,_ in pat); r1=max(r for r,_ in pat)
            c0=min(c for _,c in pat); c1=max(c for _,c in pat)
            h,w=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
            P=[[a[r0+x][c0+y] for y in range(w)] for x in range(h)]
            for r,cc in comp:
                out[r,cc]=P[(r-r0)%h][(cc-c0)%w]
    return out.tolist()
